verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review product with a documented Analytics API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows that the API exists. Nothing shows an interactive or try-it reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt, .md pages) are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here.
